facts.text: Account Closure Policy: discretionary account closure, “Pending payout requests may be canceled unless already approved and in process.” Candidate B1 for otherwise earned pending requests; approved in-process protected.
May suspend, disable or delete accounts that “harm the reputation, goodwill, or integrity of the platform.”
Permanent ban for rule violations/cheating/exploitation: refunds fees for still active, nonfailed accounts, per Trading Policy. Approved in-process payouts exception.
facts.locator: Billing, Payments, and Refunds; Account Closure Policy

facts.text: Trading Policy expressly permits cancellation of 'all unpaid and pending payouts' for activity determined abusive or unfair. Terms protect approved and in-process payouts on general closure, while Trading Policy permits all unpaid cancellation for prohibited conduct. If B1 not upheld, this supports B2; no duplicate deduction.
facts.locator: Rule Violations, Cheating, and Exploits; Enforcement; general Terms Account Closure Policy

facts.text: Trading Policy Inactivity: 'more than 30 days' inactive followed by 30 days to request reactivation. Knowledgebase: accounts purchased on or after Oct 1 2026 'permanently closed' after '14 consecutive calendar days' without trade, cannot reopen. New cohort carve-out not stated in Aug 13 Trading Policy. Verify precedence/version.
facts.locator: Account Inactivity and Closure Policy; https://purdia.com/trading-policy > Inactivity

facts.text: Payout page explicitly says displayed payouts are 'Sample data for layout preview only'. Do not use named sample payouts as actual payout proof or scale evidence.

Payout page: five evaluation days, ten sim-funded days, five $200+ profitable days in example, reach minimum payout balance once, daily payouts after qualification, transition to live at $10k sim overall profit. Knowledgebase says live position limits can change over time with assigned risk manager. No quantified consistency threshold or full product scope in captures.
